verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for HR and payroll software, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Justworks' hosted web app and PEO service (Time Off navigation, Xero integration, the enrollment process) and contains nothing about a self-hostable or on-premises deployment. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".
